en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the town of Vigo with hills in the background. In the middle stands a large multi‑storey classical building, surrounded by smaller houses and greenery. In the foreground there is a stone wall with laundry hanging over it. A circular library stamp marked 'BIBLIOTECA PUBLICA PONTEVEDRA' appears in purple at the top. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the view as seen from Calle de Policarpo Sanz in Vigo.
